audit.whatIsWrong: The two layers disagreed on six of seven rows: full-layer phases[].side said Warwick on Levels 1, 2, 3, 6 and 2+ items, while every content why on the same page said Vayne. The content win[] row was wrong too. On top of that, the content whys were off by one stage — whys[4] opened 'Level 5' while sitting in the Level 6 row, and whys[5] described level 6 while sitting in the first-item row.
audit.why: Condemn reaches 550 and Tumble (down to 2s at rank 5) resets her spacing, against a 365-range Q. Warwick has no early lead here; the packet chart and the audited mirror both give Vayne every row except Level 6.
audit.corrected: All seven rows proposed as matched full/content pairs to Vayne / Vayne / Vayne / Vayne / Skill / Vayne / Vayne with ratings moved down to match, and the off-by-one whys[4] and whys[5] re-anchored to their real stages.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why and phases[6].why sold Warwick's Blade of the Ruined King and two-item side lane as the winning spikes on rows the chart gives to Vayne.
audit.why: Vayne's first-item attack-speed spike arrives before Warwick's, and Silver Bolts deals a percentage of max health as true damage, so the two-item row is hers regardless of what Warwick builds.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why re-keyed to Condemn's 20s rank-1 window; phases[6].why now states Silver Bolts' max-health true damage and that resistances do not answer it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Condemn's terrain condition and cooldown, and Silver Bolts' true-damage type, appeared nowhere in the do's and don'ts; tradeGood and dosFull[1].d were generic filler that also called Vayne 'he'.
audit.why: Condemn (E, 20/18/16/14/12s, 550 range) knocks back and only stuns when the target collides with terrain — in open ground it is a knockback, not a stun. Silver Bolts (W) deals a percentage of max health as TRUE damage on every third hit against the same target, so armour and Plated Steelcaps do nothing about it. Blood Hunt senses her at 4000 units below 50% health and triples its bonuses below 25%.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[0].d states the 20s cooldown and terrain-only stun; dontsFull[1].d states Silver Bolts as max-health true damage; dosFull[1].d states Blood Hunt's real thresholds; tradeGood rewritten around Primal Howl's 2.5s damage reduction and fixed to 'she'.

audit.why: Whether Condemn's knockback can interrupt Infinite Duress once the suppression has connected is not in Riot's text and the mirror left it open as well.
audit.corrected: Left the existing wording alone rather than assert it either way.
